questions.text: What is the difference between a rock and a mineral?
options: Rocks are made of one or more minerals; minerals have a definite chemical composition
questions.correct: Rocks are made of one or more minerals; minerals have a definite chemical composition

questions.text: How are igneous rocks formed?
options: Cooling and solidifying of magma or lava
Heat and pressure on existing rocks
questions.correct: Cooling and solidifying of magma or lava

questions.text: Which rock type is formed from heat and pressure on existing rocks?
questions.correct: Metamorphic

questions.text: Which mineral is used to make cement?
questions.correct: Limestone

questions.text: Which soil type is BEST for most crops?
options: Loam — balanced mix of sand, silt, and clay
questions.correct: Loam — balanced mix of sand, silt, and clay

questions.text: Which Philippine province is known for its marble?
questions.correct: Romblon

questions.text: What is a tsunami usually caused by?
questions.correct: An underwater earthquake

questions.text: What is the point on Earth's surface directly above an earthquake's origin called?
questions.correct: Epicenter

questions.text: Which of the following is a SLOW geologic process?
questions.correct: Saltwater intrusion

questions.text: What is soil erosion?
options: The gradual removal of topsoil by wind, water, or human activity
questions.correct: The gradual removal of topsoil by wind, water, or human activity

questions.text: Which agency monitors volcanic and seismic activity in the Philippines?
questions.correct: PHIVOLCS

questions.text: What is the BEST response during a strong earthquake?
options: Drop, cover, and hold under a sturdy table
Take an elevator to the ground floor
questions.correct: Drop, cover, and hold under a sturdy table

questions.text: About how many tropical cyclones enter Philippine waters each year?
questions.correct: About 20

questions.text: What causes a storm surge?
options: A typhoon's strong winds and low pressure pushing sea water onto the coast
questions.correct: A typhoon's strong winds and low pressure pushing sea water onto the coast

questions.text: Which of the following is the STRONGEST part of a typhoon?
questions.correct: The eyewall

questions.text: What is the heat index?
options: The 'feels like' temperature combining heat and humidity
questions.correct: The 'feels like' temperature combining heat and humidity

questions.text: What does PAGASA stand for?
options: Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration
Philippine Agency for General Science and Astronomy
Pacific Atmospheric Group of Science Agencies
questions.correct: Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration

questions.text: What does the PAGASA iHEAT map show?
options: Real-time and forecast heat index values across the Philippines
questions.correct: Real-time and forecast heat index values across the Philippines

questions.text: Which heat index range is categorized as DANGER?
What is the urban heat island effect?
options: Cities are hotter than surrounding areas because concrete and asphalt absorb and radiate heat
Islands are always cooler than the mainland
questions.correct: Cities are hotter than surrounding areas because concrete and asphalt absorb and radiate heat
